### Meet Woman Folly
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/meet-woman-folly
Passage: Proverbs 9:13-18
Points:
- Woman Folly is presented as the counterfeit rival to Lady Wisdom, seeking to lead travelers astray.
- Loudness and widespread cultural attention do not equate to truth, since foolishness often makes the most noise without substance.
- Folly claims an illegitimate right of leadership over human lives, but only Christ can liberate us from folly.
- Forbidden pleasures tempt people by promising sweet fulfillment, but they actually result in spiritual ruin and death.
- Believers must guard their hearts through regular study of God's Word to resist the seductive appeal of sin.
